claims.claim_text: The indexed John J. Shea is a high-confidence match to the official Army bulk record.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: A nonshared protected identifier agrees across the OSS index and official Army file; the Army source form supplies the surname and given name but omits the indexed middle initial.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High confidence from the unique protected identifier and compatible name, with the source-form omission documented rather than silently corrected.
claims.temporal_assessment: The Army entry establishes wartime identity but neither a named employer nor an Army-to-OSS chronology.
claims.match_notes: Army entry-grade and occupation codes remain private and are not converted into employer evidence.

claims.claim_text: The two printed Charles W. Shearer rows are treated as one high-confidence person entity.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The adjacent index rows repeat the exact full name, Box 701 location and the same protected identifier.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High confidence for a duplicate source-row linkage because the exact name and nonshared protected identifier repeat.
claims.temporal_assessment: The repeated index rows establish source-row identity only and supply no pre-OSS employer or chronology.
claims.match_notes: Both immutable source rows remain visible and linked to the one entity; no row was deleted or silently collapsed.
